theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.77%) and Materials (+0.21%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.51%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.28%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.67%, defensives -0.51%, and value/cyclicals -0.44% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.38%, Dow -0.51%, Nasdaq -0.29% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.25%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 5.37% to 15.30, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.29% to $4,455.40, crude oil was little changed at $92.58, and bitcoin slipped 1.53% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
